gray.said: VC1 and LS1: a microphone that never answers no longer holds Studio up, and a tap to talk is answered on screen within seconds.

asks.question: Who answers between turns of a conversation?
asks.said: First, TALK's first decision. Between your turns in a conversation, who answers: a live model in seconds, the routine in hours, or branches written ahead? Live unblocks TALK3, 6 and 9, and it's the one I'd take.
asks.whyYours: It decides what a session is: a conversation in seconds, a correspondence in hours, or a script with branches. That is a product call, not a code one.

options.says: Live: home asks a model each turn, from the words only, so the reply comes in seconds
Async: the routine answers on its next pass, in hours
options.unblocks: TALK3 as a correspondence; TALK9's live scene stays out

options.says: Pre-written branches: the routine writes follow-ups ahead, and a live step picks one
options.unblocks: TALK3 and TALK6 with set replies; TALK9 plays branches

asks.question: When TOPIK keeps your level across reloads, how should the Show level filter treat it?
asks.said: Second, TOPIK's kept level. One tap on the Show level filter would hold that level for good. Should the filter remember it, with All letting go? That's the recommended one, and it lands the draft.
asks.whyYours: Only the Show level filter sets the level today, so one tap to look would hold that level for good. Whether a look counts as a choice is your call.

options.says: The filter remembers it, and All lets go of it
Only an explicit level choice is kept
options.unblocks: #2612 lands after a level control of its own is added

options.says: Keep it as it is, and say so in the store's words

asks.question: Should every GitHub Action the workflows use be pinned to a commit, rather than a version tag?
asks.said: Last, workflow security. Should every GitHub Action be pinned to a commit, or keep its version tag with the reason written down? Either way, U8 opens.
asks.whyYours: It trades a supply-chain risk against how much upkeep the workflows take, and the repos are yours to keep.

options.says: Pin every action to a commit; Dependabot moves the pins
options.unblocks: U8 opens with every unpinned finding cleared

options.says: Keep version tags, and record why in zizmor's config
options.unblocks: U8 opens with the finding set aside, and a reason
